description: Cross-run CI failure triage for GitHub Actions: group recent failed runs by root cause, classify them, and separate real regressions from flaky failures — in one page, from the command line.
name: ci-triage

prompts.description: Find what broke in CI and what to fix first: the ranked root causes with their evidence — without re-running or fixing anything until the user agrees.
prompts.name: triage_ci
prompts.text: Triage the latest CI failures for ${arguments.repo}. Call triage_repo with repo "${arguments.repo}" and report the root causes ranked by what to fix first: real regressions first, then flaky tests, then unknown, then known failures (already recorded, not new). Do not re-run, retry, or fix anything without the user agreeing.

tools.description: Triage a repo's recent failed GitHub Actions runs: fetch the failed runs, pull the failed job logs, group failures by root cause, and classify each as a test failure, build failure, infra failure, or flaky.
tools.name: triage_repo

tools.description: Triage one pasted CI job log (no network): extract the error signature and classify it as a test failure, build failure, infra failure, or unknown.
tools.name: triage_log
